description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for a parallelplot graphics object.

tr.td: stores annotation metadata for graphics tools.
Type: graphics annotation object or empty handle value. Supported values: an annotation object or an empty graphics handle.
reports whether deletion is in progress.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls callback queuing while another callback runs.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'queue', 'cancel'.
runs when the chart receives a mouse-button event.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
lists the graphics primitives used to render the chart.
Type: graphics object handle vector. Supported values: empty vector or child handles.
sets the default line color for ungrouped data.
Type: RGB triplet or color name. Supported values: a 1-by-3 numeric RGB vector or a color name such as 'r', 'g', or 'blue'.
attaches a context menu to the chart.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a uicontextmenu handle.
stores the numeric coordinate data displayed by the chart.
Type: numeric matrix. Supported values: [] or a finite numeric matrix.
sets the coordinate-axis label text.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: any character row vector or string scalar.
sets labels shown below the coordinate axes.
Type: cell array of character vectors or string vector. Supported values: one label per coordinate.
stores table variables selected for coordinates.
Type: cell array of character vectors or string vector. Supported values: [] or variable names present in the source table.
runs when the chart is created.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
stores the numeric matrix plotted as parallel coordinate rows.
Type: numeric matrix. Supported values: a nonempty numeric matrix.
sets the data-axis label text.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: any character row vector or string scalar.
selects how numeric coordinates are scaled for display.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'range', 'none'.
runs when the chart is deleted.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
sets the label used by legend-related tools.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: any character row vector or string scalar.
sets the font family used by chart text.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: installed font family names or ''.
sets the chart text size.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: positive finite scalar values.
stores grouping data used to color rows.
Type: vector. Supported values: [] or one value per data row.
stores the table variable used for grouping.
Type: text, numeric, or table selector value. Supported values: [] or a source-table variable selector.
controls handle discovery through graphics queries.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off', 'callback'.
controls whether the chart responds to mouse clicks.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
stores the inner chart rectangle.
Type: numeric row vector. Supported values: four finite values [left bottom width height].
controls interruption of running callbacks.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
sets horizontal jitter applied to coordinate positions.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: finite scalar values greater than or equal to 0.
stores tiled layout placement information.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a layout options handle.
sets the title text for the group legend.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: any character row vector or string scalar.
controls display of the group legend.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
sets line transparency.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: values from 0 through 1.
sets the style of plotted rows.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: '-', '--', ':', '-.', 'none'.
sets plotted row width.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: positive finite scalar values.
sets marker size for row vertices.
Type: finite numeric scalar. Supported values: positive finite scalar values.
sets marker style for row vertices.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'none', 'o', '+', '*', '.', 'x', and other marker symbols.
stores the outer chart rectangle.
Type: numeric row vector. Supported values: four finite values [left bottom width height].
stores the graphics parent.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: a valid graphics parent handle.
controls which visible parts can be picked.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'visible', 'all', 'none'.
stores the chart position rectangle.
Type: numeric row vector. Supported values: four finite values [left bottom width height].
selects which position rectangle is preserved during layout.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'outerposition', 'innerposition'.
controls selection state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
controls selection highlight display.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
stores the table used to create the chart.
Type: table or empty value. Supported values: [] or a table supplied to parallelplot.
stores user-defined text.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: any character row vector or string scalar.
sets chart title text.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: any character row vector or string scalar.
identifies the graphics object type.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'parallelplot'.
sets units used by position properties.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'normalized', 'pixels', 'inches', 'centimeters', 'points', 'characters'.
stores user data attached to the chart.
Type: any Nelson value. Supported values: any value.
controls chart visibility.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
